trigger.known_sign: All three frozen geometry metrics had negative observed excess; the primary positive-dispersion prediction failed.

purpose: Quantify the unexpected compactness direction transparently without reclassifying the failed pre-specified dispersion test.
population: Exactly the same 2,835 pairs and dry-route-silent k>=2 clusters as v0.1.
q_and_conditioning: Exactly the same fixed q and exact observed k conditional subset distribution as v0.1.

primary_followup.rule: Report plus-one lower-tail P and frozen-null 95% interval. Label explicitly post-readback.

deep_shallow.statistic: difference in mean pairwise-separation excess, deep minus shallow
deep_shallow.inference: two-sided Monte Carlo contrast using the same clusterwise exact-k null draws

Monte_Carlo.requirement: Reuse the same deterministic v0.1 random seed and generator so follow-up tail probabilities refer to the same frozen null construction.

interpretation_boundary: The original upper-tail dispersion prediction remains a failure.
This follow-up cannot be described as preregistered or confirmatory.
Route topology is not exact geographic distance.
RC6 cannot be upgraded or changed.
